quarter:2026-04-01.title: Simkey shows more accurate jobs, replies reliably, and verifies user phone numbers
quarter:2026-04-01.doneWhen: Job search returns more, accurate listings via an n8n workflow, Simkey replies arrive complete and readable, phone OTP send/verify/resend works with numbers saved to profiles, the new team member is onboarded, and the carried-over timeout fix is finished.

quarter:2026-07-01.title: Users get dedicated goal chats, a refreshed entry experience and Pro payments
quarter:2026-07-01.doneWhen: Every goal with a plan has its own chat in a sidebar Goal Chats section, new and returning users see updated chips and welcome messages, Pro subscriptions expire automatically with Razorpay emails, chat errors and cut-off replies are gone, and the web search work carried into October is finished.

quarter:2026-10-01.title: Simkey searches the web and remembers users across chats
quarter:2026-10-01.doneWhen: Simkey uses web search in chat and voice with results shown in the app, updated daily/monthly limits work, and the overdue cross-chat memory is finished: past chats summarised, load impact measured, and relevant summaries sent to Simkey when the gating rules call for them.

month:2026-06-01.title: Simkey shows more accurate jobs, answers reliably and verifies phone numbers
month:2026-06-01.doneWhen: Job search is no longer capped and listings are accurate, replies are no longer cut off or unreadable, phone OTP verification works with numbers saved to profiles, the new team member is onboarded, and the late timeout fix is completed.

month:2026-07-01.title: Simkey chat is stable and Pro subscriptions support payment emails and expiry
month:2026-07-01.doneWhen: Timeouts, truncated replies and 'Aborted' text are fixed, Simkey and Herkey answer from their own knowledge sources, OpenSearch is removed, Pro subscriptions expire automatically with Razorpay emails, location tracking works, and new chats record their origin.

month:2026-08-01.title: New and returning users get a guided chip-based start to Simkey, safely
month:2026-08-01.doneWhen: Chats open with a first message and updated chips that persist on refresh, 'Set A Goal' and 'Find jobs' chips lead straight into those flows, guardrails cover medical, legal and financial topics, chat fetch errors are fixed, and the Goal Action Journey tech spec is agreed.

month:2026-09-01.title: Each user goal has its own guided chat, and Simkey speaks gender-neutrally
month:2026-09-01.doneWhen: Every goal with a plan has its own chat in a sidebar Goal Chats section that rejects direct goal requests, the consumer prompt is gender neutral, profiles show after login, two male avatars are added, and the web search design and tool carried into October are finished.

month:2026-10-01.title: Simkey searches the web in chat and voice, and cross-chat memory is underway
month:2026-10-01.doneWhen: Web search works in chat and voice with results displayed, updated usage limits apply, a cross-chat memory prototype works, and past chats are backfilled with summaries, with the overdue memory lookup research continuing.

month:2026-11-01.title: Finish overdue cross-chat memory so Simkey recalls relevant past conversations
month:2026-11-01.doneWhen: Relevant past context can be found, lookup speed and database impact under concurrent load are measured, gating rules are defined, and relevant summaries reach Simkey when the rules call for them.
